most_useful_features.description: Similarity-weighted average of training delta responses, where weights are Jaccard similarities between gene sets containing the perturbation's target gene.
Binary indicators for whether gene g's protein is localized to mitochondrion, nucleus, or endoplasmic reticulum (from protein_annotation).
Interaction between the gc_cds of the perturbation target gene and the gc_cds of each response gene (product or absolute difference).
Binary feature: 1 if gene g's protein has a signal peptide, else 0.
Observed/expected CpG ratio in promoter for gene g (gene_annotation.cpg_oe_promoter), median-imputed.
Binary feature: 1 if gene g is in the transcription_factors list, else 0.
Binary feature: 1 if gene g is in any gene set whose name contains 'ATF4' or 'ATF6' (or is a neighbor of ATF4 in prior_network), else 0.
Log10 of protein_length (from protein_annotation) plus 1, per gene.
Standard deviation of gene expression across control cells.
